---
name: Experiment report
about: Share a controlled, reproducible measurement
labels: experiment
---

## Scope and authorization

Describe the environment and confirm that you own it or have written permission. Do not include private URLs or sensitive data.

## Method

Include GP-1 commit, server version, duration, concurrency, interval, timeout, request cap, warm-up, and machine details.

## Result

Share only aggregated metrics such as success rate, status codes, throughput, and p50/p95/p99 latency. Explain known limitations.
